title: One Contract, Two Deals: Electronic Trading Design of Exchange-Traded Calendar Spreads
summary: Useful execution comparison; no directional trade or independently verified savings.
about: Listed calendar spreads, synthetic legs and implied liquidity in grains and livestock.
findings: Authors report lower quoted execution costs for listed spreads, roughly half the synthetic comparison; higher implied-liquidity adverse selection with little overall realized-spread improvement. Source comparison, not our fills.
mechanism: Potential spread/legging-cost reduction rather than directional alpha.
build_on: Retain E30. Need synchronized spread/leg quote books, receipt clocks, security definitions, fees and rights for a later execution comparison. No strategy queue entry; move on.
source_revision: 57-page2026 NCCC conference version linked by author/Illinois; September13 SSRN59-page version not verified
full_text_read_scope: Connected full-PDF source review of main methods, relevant rules/results, costs, conclusions and key tables; scope detailed in linked review; no independent raw-data replication.
